thread:
Leah Kim: Scheduling a pressure + fallback drill for Aperture Dynamics' reserved pool (aperture-resv-09) Mon 03:00 UTC. Goal: validate autoscale, queue-shed, and rollback. Runbook: https://playbooks.internal/redwood/aperture-pressure-drill :zap:
Owen Brooks: I'll build the traffic mix. Plan: steady gen 6k rps + 3x chat spikes to 45k rps for 90s with jitter. Tag header X-Test:aperture-1849999999.
Diego Morales: I'll monitor scale events, allocator logs, GPU util, KV hit-rate. Manual fallback if median queue >75s. Which fallback policy?
Leah Kim: Use 'queue-shed-85pct' so embeds shed first. Stop warmers to force cold paths.
Riley Chen: Notified customer PM; they asked for a 5m dry-run Sun 22:00 UTC to validate certs/access. I'll handle comms.
Owen Brooks: Dry-run OK. Harness: k6 for gen/embed, vegeta for chat spikes. Example k6 payload:```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){http.post('https://api.redwood.test/generate',{prompt:'test'});}```
eng-deploy-bot: Preflight: pool=aperture-resv-09, gpus=24, headroom=22%, maintenance windows clear.
Diego Morales: Temp alerts I'll set: promql "sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1m])) by (pool) > 4000" and "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool)) > 1.5". Will annotate dashboards.
Leah Kim: Timeline: Sun 22:00 dry-run (10m) -> Mon 03:00 canary burst (3m) -> 03:05 ramp cycles -> 03:40 cooldown + samples. Roles: Owen=load, Diego=monitor, Riley=customer ops, Leah=orchestration.
Owen Brooks: Load script will disable KV prefix caching and inject 2% malformed payloads to test error surfaces.
Diego Morales: Rollback play: pause routing -> switch to fallback model rwd-base-1.1 -> scale down new pool by 30% -> remove policy after stable. I'll pre-create k8s drain cmds.
Riley Chen: I'll post a short post-test note and attach the quality sample link. If >2 degraded events we flag renewal risks in the account note.
Leah Kim: Final pre-checks: disable warmers, push temp alerts, set quota policy=queue-shed-85pct, merge harness branch by EOW. Reconvene 2h before windows here. :white_check_mark:
